_comment: A summoned totem's fire dot: applies to the nearest enemy within 1.5 units every 60 ticks, dealing 8 HP plus 2 per level over 3 ticks at 60-tick intervals. The totem's level is copied from the SummonTotem skill at spawn, so this skill's maxLevel must stay equal to SummonTotem's. All values placeholder.
name: TotemAura
